lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice Swedish V2 word order after simple time and place openings.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Morning small talk at work about today's schedule.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Describing what happens today and where someone is working.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk briefly about their morning, where they are working today, and when they start or have meetings.

main_focus.name: V2 word order after time expressions
main_focus.description: Place the finite verb second when a sentence begins with a time or place phrase.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use V2 after an opening time or place phrase naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use time phrases in practical workday sentences without making the exchange feel like a grammar drill.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks how the morning is going.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare today's work location, start time, and one simple plan after work.
dialogue_shape.ending: They wish each other a good day or head to a meeting.

target_complexity.repetition: include several parallel V2 sentences with idag, på morgonen, or efter jobbet

focus: where each speaker is working today
what one speaker does in the morning
what happens after work or before a meeting

sentence_focus: one sentence beginning with på morgonen
one sentence about working at home
